say:1:1430236101:1.text: Yes, with a tree this big, they probably planted it when they built the Tenebris Court.

say:2:1430236102:1.text: Why would the Essail plant a tree in front of such a holy location...? I'm sure if we dig deeper, we'll discover something incredible.
